# ŌLLIN

> ŌLLIN finds the signal and the people behind it, and turns it into outreach
> you approve. ŌLLIN OS finds it. ŌLLIN GO runs it. Nothing sends without your yes.
> An ELIPAN Group company.

## Products
- ŌLLIN OS: finds the business moment, connects it to the person who matters, and shows the evidence. Every fact is sourced. Gaps stay visible as "unable to verify".
- ŌLLIN GO: turns that intelligence into a campaign. You review the message and decide what happens next.

## Features
- [Client mapping](https://www.ollinos.com/client-mapping): start with one person and see the people around them. Every line is labelled confirmed or inferred.
- [Campaigns](https://www.ollinos.com/campaigns): every touch built from a verified fact, approved by you, sent in the morning. Nothing sends without your yes.
- [Redeploy](https://www.ollinos.com/redeploy): for staffing firms. Starts from your consultant, not a job board, and lines up the next seat before the last one ends. Their name stays private.

## How it works
Full page: https://www.ollinos.com/how-we-work
- Show the evidence: the source stays next to the signal.
- Say what is unknown: "unable to verify" is shown, not hidden.
- Keep people in charge: nothing sends without your approval.
